t: NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover Collects Samples

img.cap: A collage of 49 pictures of different holes drilled by NASA's Curiosity rover into Mars' surface. The rocks in each photo are different shades of red-brown, from a deep adobe color to beige.

p: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS This Nov. 16 collage shows 49 drill holes captured by NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover as of November 2026. Each hole represents a sample collected from rocks on the Martian surface; Curiosity’s drill, located on the end of its robotic arm, drops pulverized rock samples into instruments in its belly that analyze their composition.
